verdict.rationale: The BILL v3 API exposes S&E transaction/card management endpoints and webhooks (docs-2, docs-3, docs-9), and BILL's own 'Invoice Coding Agent' does AI-driven coding (docs-8), suggesting some data plumbing exists for coding transactions. However, the only MCP server documented is for browsing API documentation in coding tools like Cursor/Claude Desktop (docs-18), not for pulling live uncoded transactions or pushing coding decisions back into BILL, and there's no explicit endpoint or workflow described for an external agent to fetch 'uncoded' transactions, propose categorizations/policy flags, and submit them for human review. Missing for 10: a transactional MCP server (not just docs) or explicit API endpoints/recipes for uncoded-transaction retrieval and coding submission, and evidence of a review/approval loop for agent-proposed coding.
